segments.mn105:1.1: Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
segments.mn105:2.1: Tena kho pana samayena sambahulehi bhikkhūhi bhagavato santike aññā byākatā hoti –
segments.mn105:2.2: “‘khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti pajānāmā”ti.
segments.mn105:2.4: “sambahulehi kira bhikkhūhi bhagavato santike aññā byākatā hoti –
segments.mn105:2.5: ‘khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti pajānāmā”ti.
segments.mn105:3.1: Atha kho sunakkhatto licchaviputto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho sunakkhatto licchaviputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn105:4.2: ‘sambahulehi kira bhikkhūhi bhagavato santike aññā byākatā – khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti pajānāmā”ti.
segments.mn105:4.4: “Ye te, bhante, bhikkhū bhagavato santike aññaṃ byākaṃsu –
segments.mn105:4.5: ‘khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti pajānāmā”ti, kacci te, bhante, bhikkhū sammadeva aññaṃ byākaṃsu udāhu santetthekacce bhikkhū adhimānena aññaṃ byākaṃsūti?
segments.mn105:5.1: “Ye te, sunakkhatta, bhikkhū mama santike aññaṃ byākaṃsu –
segments.mn105:5.2: ‘khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti pajānāmā”ti.
segments.mn105:5.3: “Santetthekacce bhikkhū sammadeva aññaṃ byākaṃsu, santi panidhekacce bhikkhū adhimānenapi [adhimānena (?)] aññaṃ byākaṃsu.
segments.mn105:5.4: Tatra, sunakkhatta, ye te bhikkhū sammadeva aññaṃ byākaṃsu tesaṃ taṃ tatheva hoti;
segments.mn105:5.5: ye pana te bhikkhū adhimānena aññaṃ byākaṃsu tatra, sunakkhatta, tathāgatassa evaṃ hoti –
segments.mn105:5.9: Atha ca panidhekacce moghapurisā pañhaṃ abhisaṅkharitvā abhisaṅkharitvā tathāgataṃ upasaṅkamitvā pucchanti.
segments.mn105:5.10: Tatra, sunakkhatta, yampi tathāgatassa evaṃ hoti –
segments.mn105:6.1: “Etassa bhagavā kālo, etassa sugata kālo, yaṃ bhagavā dhammaṃ deseyya.
segments.mn105:6.3: “Tena hi, sunakkhatta suṇāhi, sādhukaṃ manasi karohi; bhāsissāmī”ti.
segments.mn105:6.4: “Evaṃ, bhante”ti kho sunakkhatto licchaviputto bhagavato paccassosi.
segments.mn105:7.3: Cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā, sotaviññeyyā saddā … pe … ghānaviññeyyā gandhā … jivhāviññeyyā rasā … kāyaviññeyyā phoṭṭhabbā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā – ime kho, sunakkhatta, pañca kāmaguṇā.
segments.mn105:8.1: “Ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ, sunakkhatta, vijjati yaṃ idhekacco purisapuggalo lokāmisādhimutto assa.
segments.mn105:8.2: Lokāmisādhimuttassa kho, sunakkhatta, purisapuggalassa tappatirūpī ceva kathā saṇṭhāti, tadanudhammañca anuvitakketi, anuvicāreti, tañca purisaṃ bhajati, tena ca vittiṃ āpajjati;
segments.mn105:8.3: āneñjapaṭisaṃyuttāya ca pana kathāya kacchamānāya na sussūsati, na sotaṃ odahati, na aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhāpeti [upaṭṭhapeti (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)], na ca taṃ purisaṃ bhajati, na ca tena vittiṃ āpajjati.
segments.mn105:9.1: Seyyathāpi, sunakkhatta, puriso sakamhā gāmā vā nigamā vā ciravippavuttho assa.
segments.mn105:9.2: So aññataraṃ purisaṃ passeyya tamhā gāmā vā nigamā vā acirapakkantaṃ.
segments.mn105:9.3: So taṃ purisaṃ tassa gāmassa vā nigamassa vā khematañca subhikkhatañca appābādhatañca puccheyya;
segments.mn105:9.4: tassa so puriso tassa gāmassa vā nigamassa vā khematañca subhikkhatañca appābādhatañca saṃseyya.
segments.mn105:9.5: Taṃ kiṃ maññasi, sunakkhatta, api nu so puriso tassa purisassa sussūseyya, sotaṃ odaheyya, aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhāpeyya, tañca purisaṃ bhajeyya, tena ca vittiṃ āpajjeyyā”ti?
segments.mn105:9.8: “Evameva kho, sunakkhatta, ṭhānametaṃ vijjati yaṃ idhekacco purisapuggalo lokāmisādhimutto assa.
segments.mn105:9.9: Lokāmisādhimuttassa kho, sunakkhatta, purisapuggalassa tappatirūpī ceva kathā saṇṭhāti, tadanudhammañca anuvitakketi, anuvicāreti, tañca purisaṃ bhajati, tena ca vittiṃ āpajjati;
segments.mn105:9.10: āneñjapaṭisaṃyuttāya ca pana kathāya kacchamānāya na sussūsati, na sotaṃ odahati, na aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhāpeti, na ca taṃ purisaṃ bhajati, na ca tena vittiṃ āpajjati.
segments.mn105:9.12: ‘āneñjasaṃyojanena hi kho visaṃyutto [āneñjasaṃyojanena hi kho visaṃyutto-iti pāṭho sī. syā. kaṃ. pī. potthakesu natthi, aṭṭhakathāsu pana tabbaṇṇanā dissatiyeva] lokāmisādhimutto purisapuggalo’”ti.
segments.mn105:10.1: “Ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ, sunakkhatta, vijjati yaṃ idhekacco purisapuggalo āneñjādhimutto assa.
segments.mn105:10.2: Āneñjādhimuttassa kho, sunakkhatta, purisapuggalassa tappatirūpī ceva kathā saṇṭhāti, tadanudhammañca anuvitakketi, anuvicāreti, tañca purisaṃ bhajati, tena ca vittiṃ āpajjati;
segments.mn105:10.3: lokāmisapaṭisaṃyuttāya ca pana kathāya kacchamānāya na sussūsati, na sotaṃ odahati, na aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhāpeti, na ca taṃ purisaṃ bhajati, na ca tena vittiṃ āpajjati.
segments.mn105:11.1: Seyyathāpi, sunakkhatta, paṇḍupalāso bandhanā pavutto abhabbo haritattāya;
segments.mn105:11.2: evameva kho, sunakkhatta, āneñjādhimuttassa purisapuggalassa ye lokāmisasaṃyojane se pavutte.
segments.mn105:12.1: “Ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ, sunakkhatta, vijjati yaṃ idhekacco purisapuggalo ākiñcaññāyatanādhimutto assa.
segments.mn105:12.2: Ākiñcaññāyatanādhimuttassa kho, sunakkhatta, purisapuggalassa tappatirūpī ceva kathā saṇṭhāti, tadanudhammañca anuvitakketi, anuvicāreti, tañca purisaṃ bhajati, tena ca vittiṃ āpajjati;
segments.mn105:12.3: āneñjapaṭisaṃyuttāya ca pana kathāya kacchamānāya na sussūsati, na sotaṃ odahati, na aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhāpeti, na ca taṃ purisaṃ bhajati, na ca tena vittiṃ āpajjati.
segments.mn105:13.1: Seyyathāpi, sunakkhatta, puthusilā dvedhābhinnā appaṭisandhikā hoti;
segments.mn105:13.2: evameva kho, sunakkhatta, ākiñcaññāyatanādhimuttassa purisapuggalassa ye āneñjasaṃyojane se bhinne.
segments.mn105:14.1: “Ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ, sunakkhatta, vijjati yaṃ idhekacco purisapuggalo nevasaññānāsaññāyatanādhimutto assa.
segments.mn105:14.2: Nevasaññānāsaññāyatanādhimuttassa kho, sunakkhatta, purisapuggalassa tappatirūpī ceva kathā saṇṭhāti, tadanudhammañca anuvitakketi, anuvicāreti, tañca purisaṃ bhajati, tena ca vittiṃ āpajjati;
segments.mn105:14.3: ākiñcaññāyatanapaṭisaṃyuttāya ca pana kathāya kacchamānāya na sussūsati, na sotaṃ odahati, na aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhāpeti, na ca taṃ purisaṃ bhajati, na ca tena vittiṃ āpajjati.
segments.mn105:15.1: Seyyathāpi, sunakkhatta, puriso manuññabhojanaṃ bhuttāvī chaḍḍeyya [chaddeyya (?)].
segments.mn105:15.2: Taṃ kiṃ maññasi, sunakkhatta, api nu tassa purisassa tasmiṃ bhatte [vante (ka. sī.), bhutte (ka. sī. ka.)] puna bhottukamyatā assā”ti?
segments.mn105:15.7: “Evameva kho, sunakkhatta, nevasaññānāsaññāyatanādhimuttassa purisapuggalassa ye ākiñcaññāyatanasaṃyojane se vante.
segments.mn105:16.1: “Ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ, sunakkhatta, vijjati yaṃ idhekacco purisapuggalo sammā nibbānādhimutto assa.
segments.mn105:16.2: Sammā nibbānādhimuttassa kho, sunakkhatta, purisapuggalassa tappatirūpī ceva kathā saṇṭhāti, tadanudhammañca anuvitakketi, anuvicāreti, tañca purisaṃ bhajati, tena ca vittiṃ āpajjati;
segments.mn105:16.3: nevasaññānāsaññāyatanapaṭisaṃyuttāya ca pana kathāya kacchamānāya na sussūsati, na sotaṃ odahati, na aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhāpeti, na ca taṃ purisaṃ bhajati, na ca tena vittiṃ āpajjati.
segments.mn105:17.1: Seyyathāpi, sunakkhatta, tālo matthakacchinno abhabbo puna viruḷhiyā;
segments.mn105:17.2: evameva kho, sunakkhatta, sammā nibbānādhimuttassa purisapuggalassa ye nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasaṃyojane se ucchinnamūle tālāvatthukate anabhāvaṃkate [anabhāvakate (sī. pī.), anabhāvaṅgate (syā. kaṃ.)] āyatiṃ anuppādadhamme.
segments.mn105:17.4: ‘nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasaṃyojanena hi kho visaṃyutto sammā nibbānādhimutto purisapuggalo’”ti.
segments.mn105:18.1: “Ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ, sunakkhatta, vijjati yaṃ idhekaccassa bhikkhuno evamassa –
segments.mn105:18.2: ‘taṇhā kho sallaṃ samaṇena vuttaṃ, avijjāvisadoso, chandarāgabyāpādena ruppati.
segments.mn105:18.3: Taṃ me taṇhāsallaṃ pahīnaṃ, apanīto avijjāvisadoso, sammā nibbānādhimuttohamasmī’ti.
segments.mn105:18.4: Evaṃmāni [evaṃmānī (sī. pī. ka.), evamādi (syā. kaṃ.)] assa atathaṃ samānaṃ [atthaṃ samānaṃ (syā. kaṃ. pī.), atthasamānaṃ (sī.)].
segments.mn105:18.5: So yāni sammā nibbānādhimuttassa asappāyāni tāni anuyuñjeyya; asappāyaṃ cakkhunā rūpadassanaṃ anuyuñjeyya, asappāyaṃ sotena saddaṃ anuyuñjeyya, asappāyaṃ ghānena gandhaṃ anuyuñjeyya, asappāyaṃ jivhāya rasaṃ anuyuñjeyya, asappāyaṃ kāyena phoṭṭhabbaṃ anuyuñjeyya, asappāyaṃ manasā dhammaṃ anuyuñjeyya.
segments.mn105:18.6: Tassa asappāyaṃ cakkhunā rūpadassanaṃ anuyuttassa, asappāyaṃ sotena saddaṃ anuyuttassa, asappāyaṃ ghānena gandhaṃ anuyuttassa, asappāyaṃ jivhāya rasaṃ anuyuttassa, asappāyaṃ kāyena phoṭṭhabbaṃ anuyuttassa, asappāyaṃ manasā dhammaṃ anuyuttassa rāgo cittaṃ anuddhaṃseyya.
segments.mn105:18.7: So rāgānuddhaṃsitena cittena maraṇaṃ vā nigaccheyya maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhaṃ.
segments.mn105:19.1: “Seyyathāpi, sunakkhatta, puriso sallena viddho assa savisena gāḷhūpalepanena.
segments.mn105:19.2: Tassa mittāmaccā ñātisālohitā bhisakkaṃ sallakattaṃ upaṭṭhāpeyyuṃ.
segments.mn105:19.3: Tassa so bhisakko sallakatto satthena vaṇamukhaṃ parikanteyya.
segments.mn105:19.4: Satthena vaṇamukhaṃ parikantitvā esaniyā sallaṃ eseyya.
segments.mn105:19.5: Esaniyā sallaṃ esitvā sallaṃ abbuheyya, apaneyya visadosaṃ saupādisesaṃ.
segments.mn105:19.6: Saupādisesoti [anupādisesoti (sabbattha) ayaṃ hi tathāgatassa visayo] jānamāno so evaṃ vadeyya –
segments.mn105:19.7: ‘ambho purisa, ubbhataṃ kho te sallaṃ, apanīto visadoso saupādiseso [anupādiseso (sabbattha) ayampi tathāgatassa visayo].
segments.mn105:19.9: Sappāyāni ceva bhojanāni bhuñjeyyāsi, mā te asappāyāni bhojanāni bhuñjato vaṇo assāvī assa.
segments.mn105:19.10: Kālena kālañca vaṇaṃ dhoveyyāsi, kālena kālaṃ vaṇamukhaṃ ālimpeyyāsi, mā te na kālena kālaṃ vaṇaṃ dhovato na kālena kālaṃ vaṇamukhaṃ ālimpato pubbalohitaṃ vaṇamukhaṃ pariyonandhi.
segments.mn105:19.11: Mā ca vātātape cārittaṃ anuyuñji, mā te vātātape cārittaṃ anuyuttassa rajosūkaṃ vaṇamukhaṃ anuddhaṃsesi.
segments.mn105:19.12: Vaṇānurakkhī ca, ambho purisa, vihareyyāsi vaṇasāropī’ti [vaṇassāropīti (ka.) vaṇa + saṃ + ropī = vaṇasāropī-iti padavibhāgo].
segments.mn105:20.2: ‘ubbhataṃ kho me sallaṃ, apanīto visadoso anupādiseso.
segments.mn105:20.4: So asappāyāni ceva bhojanāni bhuñjeyya. Tassa asappāyāni bhojanāni bhuñjato vaṇo assāvī assa.
segments.mn105:20.5: Na ca kālena kālaṃ vaṇaṃ dhoveyya, na ca kālena kālaṃ vaṇamukhaṃ ālimpeyya. Tassa na kālena kālaṃ vaṇaṃ dhovato, na kālena kālaṃ vaṇamukhaṃ ālimpato pubbalohitaṃ vaṇamukhaṃ pariyonandheyya.
segments.mn105:20.6: Vātātape ca cārittaṃ anuyuñjeyya. Tassa vātātape cārittaṃ anuyuttassa rajosūkaṃ vaṇamukhaṃ anuddhaṃseyya.
segments.mn105:20.7: Na ca vaṇānurakkhī vihareyya na vaṇasāropī.
segments.mn105:20.8: Tassa imissā ca asappāyakiriyāya, asuci visadoso apanīto saupādiseso tadubhayena vaṇo puthuttaṃ gaccheyya.
segments.mn105:20.9: So puthuttaṃ gatena vaṇena maraṇaṃ vā nigaccheyya maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhaṃ.
segments.mn105:21.1: “Evameva kho, sunakkhatta, ṭhānametaṃ vijjati yaṃ idhekaccassa bhikkhuno evamassa –
segments.mn105:21.2: ‘taṇhā kho sallaṃ samaṇena vuttaṃ, avijjāvisadoso chandarāgabyāpādena ruppati.
segments.mn105:21.3: Taṃ me taṇhāsallaṃ pahīnaṃ, apanīto avijjāvisadoso, sammā nibbānādhimuttohamasmī’ti.
segments.mn105:21.5: So yāni sammā nibbānādhimuttassa asappāyāni tāni anuyuñjeyya, asappāyaṃ cakkhunā rūpadassanaṃ anuyuñjeyya, asappāyaṃ sotena saddaṃ anuyuñjeyya, asappāyaṃ ghānena gandhaṃ anuyuñjeyya, asappāyaṃ jivhāya rasaṃ anuyuñjeyya, asappāyaṃ kāyena phoṭṭhabbaṃ anuyuñjeyya, asappāyaṃ manasā dhammaṃ anuyuñjeyya.
segments.mn105:21.6: Tassa asappāyaṃ cakkhunā rūpadassanaṃ anuyuttassa, asappāyaṃ sotena saddaṃ anuyuttassa, asappāyaṃ ghānena gandhaṃ anuyuttassa, asappāyaṃ jivhāya rasaṃ anuyuttassa, asappāyaṃ kāyena phoṭṭhabbaṃ anuyuttassa, asappāyaṃ manasā dhammaṃ anuyuttassa rāgo cittaṃ anuddhaṃseyya.
segments.mn105:21.7: So rāgānuddhaṃsitena cittena maraṇaṃ vā nigaccheyya maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhaṃ.
segments.mn105:22.1: Maraṇañhetaṃ, sunakkhatta, ariyassa vinaye yo sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattati;
segments.mn105:22.2: maraṇamattañhetaṃ, sunakkhatta, dukkhaṃ yaṃ aññataraṃ saṃkiliṭṭhaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjati.
segments.mn105:23.1: “Ṭhānaṃ kho panetaṃ, sunakkhatta, vijjati yaṃ idhekaccassa bhikkhuno evamassa –
segments.mn105:23.2: ‘taṇhā kho sallaṃ samaṇena vuttaṃ, avijjāvisadoso chandarāgabyāpādena ruppati.
segments.mn105:23.3: Taṃ me taṇhāsallaṃ pahīnaṃ, apanīto avijjāvisadoso, sammā nibbānādhimuttohamasmī’ti.
segments.mn105:23.4: Sammā nibbānādhimuttasseva sato so yāni sammā nibbānādhimuttassa asappāyāni tāni nānuyuñjeyya, asappāyaṃ cakkhunā rūpadassanaṃ nānuyuñjeyya, asappāyaṃ sotena saddaṃ nānuyuñjeyya, asappāyaṃ ghānena gandhaṃ nānuyuñjeyya, asappāyaṃ jivhāya rasaṃ nānuyuñjeyya, asappāyaṃ kāyena phoṭṭhabbaṃ nānuyuñjeyya, asappāyaṃ manasā dhammaṃ nānuyuñjeyya.
segments.mn105:23.5: Tassa asappāyaṃ cakkhunā rūpadassanaṃ nānuyuttassa, asappāyaṃ sotena saddaṃ nānuyuttassa, asappāyaṃ ghānena gandhaṃ nānuyuttassa, asappāyaṃ jivhāya rasaṃ nānuyuttassa, asappāyaṃ kāyena phoṭṭhabbaṃ nānuyuttassa, asappāyaṃ manasā dhammaṃ nānuyuttassa rāgo cittaṃ nānuddhaṃseyya.
segments.mn105:23.6: So na rāgānuddhaṃsitena cittena neva maraṇaṃ vā nigaccheyya na maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhaṃ.
segments.mn105:24.1: “Seyyathāpi, sunakkhatta, puriso sallena viddho assa savisena gāḷhūpalepanena.
segments.mn105:24.2: Tassa mittāmaccā ñātisālohitā bhisakkaṃ sallakattaṃ upaṭṭhāpeyyuṃ.
segments.mn105:24.3: Tassa so bhisakko sallakatto satthena vaṇamukhaṃ parikanteyya.
segments.mn105:24.4: Satthena vaṇamukhaṃ parikantitvā esaniyā sallaṃ eseyya.
segments.mn105:24.5: Esaniyā sallaṃ esitvā sallaṃ abbuheyya, apaneyya visadosaṃ anupādisesaṃ.
segments.mn105:24.7: ‘ambho purisa, ubbhataṃ kho te sallaṃ, apanīto visadoso anupādiseso.
segments.mn105:24.9: Sappāyāni ceva bhojanāni bhuñjeyyāsi, mā te asappāyāni bhojanāni bhuñjato vaṇo assāvī assa.
segments.mn105:24.10: Kālena kālañca vaṇaṃ dhoveyyāsi, kālena kālaṃ vaṇamukhaṃ ālimpeyyāsi. Mā te na kālena kālaṃ vaṇaṃ dhovato na kālena kālaṃ vaṇamukhaṃ ālimpato pubbalohitaṃ vaṇamukhaṃ pariyonandhi.
segments.mn105:24.11: Mā ca vātātape cārittaṃ anuyuñji, mā te vātātape cārittaṃ anuyuttassa rajosūkaṃ vaṇamukhaṃ anuddhaṃsesi.
segments.mn105:24.12: Vaṇānurakkhī ca, ambho purisa, vihareyyāsi vaṇasāropī’ti.
segments.mn105:25.2: ‘ubbhataṃ kho me sallaṃ, apanīto visadoso anupādiseso.
segments.mn105:25.4: So sappāyāni ceva bhojanāni bhuñjeyya. Tassa sappāyāni bhojanāni bhuñjato vaṇo na assāvī assa.
segments.mn105:25.5: Kālena kālañca vaṇaṃ dhoveyya, kālena kālaṃ vaṇamukhaṃ ālimpeyya. Tassa kālena kālaṃ vaṇaṃ dhovato kālena kālaṃ vaṇamukhaṃ ālimpato na pubbalohitaṃ vaṇamukhaṃ pariyonandheyya.
segments.mn105:25.6: Na ca vātātape cārittaṃ anuyuñjeyya. Tassa vātātape cārittaṃ ananuyuttassa rajosūkaṃ vaṇamukhaṃ nānuddhaṃseyya.
segments.mn105:25.8: Tassa imissā ca sappāyakiriyāya asu ca [asuci (sabbattha) socāti tabbaṇṇanā manasikātabbā] visadoso apanīto anupādiseso tadubhayena vaṇo viruheyya.
segments.mn105:25.9: So ruḷhena vaṇena sañchavinā neva maraṇaṃ vā nigaccheyya na maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhaṃ.
segments.mn105:26.1: “Evameva kho, sunakkhatta, ṭhānametaṃ vijjati yaṃ idhekaccassa bhikkhuno evamassa –
segments.mn105:26.2: ‘taṇhā kho sallaṃ samaṇena vuttaṃ, avijjāvisadoso chandarāgabyāpādena ruppati.
segments.mn105:26.3: Taṃ me taṇhāsallaṃ pahīnaṃ, apanīto avijjāvisadoso, sammā nibbānādhimuttohamasmī’ti.
segments.mn105:26.4: Sammā nibbānādhimuttasseva sato so yāni sammā nibbānādhimuttassa asappāyāni tāni nānuyuñjeyya, asappāyaṃ cakkhunā rūpadassanaṃ nānuyuñjeyya, asappāyaṃ sotena saddaṃ nānuyuñjeyya, asappāyaṃ ghānena gandhaṃ nānuyuñjeyya, asappāyaṃ jivhāya rasaṃ nānuyuñjeyya, asappāyaṃ kāyena phoṭṭhabbaṃ nānuyuñjeyya, asappāyaṃ manasā dhammaṃ nānuyuñjeyya.
segments.mn105:26.5: Tassa asappāyaṃ cakkhunā rūpadassanaṃ nānuyuttassa, asappāyaṃ sotena saddaṃ nānuyuttassa, asappāyaṃ ghānena gandhaṃ nānuyuttassa, asappāyaṃ jivhāya rasaṃ nānuyuttassa, asappāyaṃ kāyena phoṭṭhabbaṃ nānuyuttassa, asappāyaṃ manasā dhammaṃ nānuyuttassa, rāgo cittaṃ nānuddhaṃseyya.
segments.mn105:26.6: So na rāgānuddhaṃsitena cittena neva maraṇaṃ vā nigaccheyya na maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhaṃ.
segments.mn105:27.1: “Upamā kho me ayaṃ, sunakkhatta, katā atthassa viññāpanāya.
segments.mn105:27.2: Ayaṃyevettha attho – vaṇoti kho, sunakkhatta, channetaṃ ajjhattikānaṃ āyatanānaṃ adhivacanaṃ;
segments.mn105:27.7: satthanti kho, sunakkhatta, ariyāyetaṃ paññāya adhivacanaṃ;
segments.mn105:27.8: bhisakko sallakattoti kho, sunakkhatta, tathāgatassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassa.
segments.mn105:28.1: “So vata, sunakkhatta, bhikkhu chasu phassāyatanesu saṃvutakārī ‘upadhi dukkhassa mūlan’ti – iti viditvā nirupadhi upadhisaṅkhaye vimutto upadhismiṃ vā kāyaṃ upasaṃharissati cittaṃ vā uppādessatīti – netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
segments.mn105:29.1: Seyyathāpi, sunakkhatta, āpānīyakaṃso vaṇṇasampanno gandhasampanno rasasampanno;
segments.mn105:29.3: Atha puriso āgaccheyya jīvitukāmo amaritukāmo sukhakāmo dukkhapaṭikūlo.
segments.mn105:29.4: Taṃ kiṃ maññasi, sunakkhatta, api nu so puriso amuṃ āpānīyakaṃsaṃ piveyya yaṃ jaññā –
segments.mn105:29.6: ‘imāhaṃ pivitvā maraṇaṃ vā nigacchāmi maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhan’”ti?
segments.mn105:29.8: “Evameva kho, sunakkhatta, so vata bhikkhu chasu phassāyatanesu saṃvutakārī ‘upadhi dukkhassa mūlan’ti – iti viditvā nirupadhi upadhisaṅkhaye vimutto upadhismiṃ vā kāyaṃ upasaṃharissati cittaṃ vā uppādessatīti – netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
segments.mn105:30.2: Atha puriso āgaccheyya jīvitukāmo amaritukāmo sukhakāmo dukkhapaṭikūlo.
segments.mn105:30.3: Taṃ kiṃ maññasi, sunakkhatta, api nu so puriso amussa āsīvisassa ghoravisassa hatthaṃ vā aṅguṭṭhaṃ vā dajjā [yuñjeyya (ka.)] yaṃ jaññā –
segments.mn105:30.5: ‘imināhaṃ daṭṭho maraṇaṃ vā nigacchāmi maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhan’”ti?
segments.mn105:30.7: “Evameva kho, sunakkhatta, so vata bhikkhu chasu phassāyatanesu saṃvutakārī ‘upadhi dukkhassa mūlan’ti – iti viditvā nirupadhi upadhisaṅkhaye vimutto upadhismiṃ vā kāyaṃ upasaṃharissati cittaṃ vā uppādessatīti – netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjatī”ti.
segments.mn105:30.11: Attamano sunakkhatto licchaviputto bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandīti.

lines: Adhimānenāti appatte pattasaññino, anadhigate adhigatasaññino hutvā adhigataṃ amhehīti mānena byākariṃsu.
Evañcettha sunakkhatta tathāgatassa hotīti sunakkhatta ettha etesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pañhabyākaraṇe –
“idaṃ ṭhānaṃ etesaṃ avibhūtaṃ andhakāraṃ, tenime anadhigate adhigatasaññino, handa nesaṃ visodhetvā pākaṭaṃ katvā dhammaṃ desemī”ti, evañca tathāgatassa hoti.
Atha ca panidhekacce … pe … tassapi hoti aññathattanti bhagavā paṭipannakānaṃ dhammaṃ deseti.
Yattha pana icchācāre ṭhitā ekacce moghapurisā honti, tatra bhagavā passati –

“ime imaṃ pañhaṃ uggahetvā ajānitvāva jānantā viya appatte pattasaññino hutvā gāmanigamādīsu visevamānā vicarissanti, taṃ nesaṃ bhavissati dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāyā”ti evamassāyaṃ icchācāre ṭhitānaṃ kāraṇā paṭipannakānampi atthāya “dhammaṃ desissāmī”ti uppannassa cittassa aññathābhāvo hoti.
Lokāmisādhimuttoti vaṭṭāmisa-kāmāmisa-lokāmisabhūtesu pañcasu kāmaguṇesu adhimutto tanninno taggaruko tappabbhāro.

Lokāmisādhimuttoti evarūpo hi lūkhacīvaradharo mattikāpattaṃ ādāya attano sadisehi katipayehi saddhiṃ paccantajanapadaṃ gacchati, gāmaṃ piṇḍāya paviṭṭhakāle manussā disvā “mahāpaṃsukulikā āgatā”ti yāgubhattādīni sampādetvā sakkaccaṃ dānaṃ denti, bhattakicce niṭṭhite anumodanaṃ sutvā –
Alaṃ upāsakā, ajjāpi vo bahūnaṃ dinnanti.
Tena hi, bhante, antovassaṃ idha vaseyyāthāti adhivāsetvā vihāramaggaṃ pucchitvā vihāraṃ gacchanti.
Sāyaṃ eko āvāsiko te bhikkhū pucchati “kattha piṇḍāya caritthā”ti?
Āma evarūpā nāma manussānaṃ saddhā hoti.
“Ajjeva nu kho ete edisā, niccampi edisā”ti?
Saddhā te manussā niccampi edisā, te nissāyeva ayaṃ vihāro vaḍḍhatīti.
Tato te paṃsukulikā punappunaṃ tesaṃ vaṇṇaṃ kathenti, divasāvasesaṃ kathetvā rattimpi kathenti.
Ettāvatā icchācāre ṭhitassa sīsaṃ nikkhantaṃ hoti udaraṃ phālitaṃ.
Idāni āneñjasamāpattilābhiṃ adhimānikaṃ dassento ṭhānaṃ kho panetantiādimāha.
Āneñjādhimuttassāti kilesasiñcanavirahitāsu heṭṭhimāsu chasu samāpattīsu adhimuttassa tanninnassa taggaruno tappabbhārassa.
Cha samāpattilābhino hi adhimānikassa pañcakāmaguṇāmisabandhanā patitapaṇḍupalāso viya upaṭṭhāti.
Idāni ākiñcaññāyatanasamāpatti lābhino adhimānikassa nighaṃsaṃ dassetuṃ ṭhānaṃ kho panātiādimāha.
Appaṭisandhikāti khuddakā muṭṭhipāsāṇamattā jatunā vā silesena vā allīyāpetvā paṭisandhātuṃ sakkā.
Upari samāpattilābhino hi heṭṭhāsamāpatti dvedhābhinnā selā viya hoti, taṃ samāpajjissāmīti cittaṃ na uppajjati.
Idāni nevasaññānāsaññāyatanalābhino adhimānikassa ca nighaṃsaṃ dassento ṭhānaṃ kho panātiādimāha.
Aṭṭhasamāpattilābhino hi heṭṭhāsamāpattiyo vantasadisā hutvā upaṭṭhahanti, puna samāpajjissāmīti cittaṃ na uppajjati.
Idāni khīṇāsavassa nighaṃsaṃ dassento ṭhānaṃ kho panātiādimāha.
Upari samāpattilābhino hi heṭṭhāsamāpatti mūlacchinnatālo viya upaṭṭhāti, taṃ samāpajjissāmīti cittaṃ na uppajjati.
Heṭṭhā hi samāpattilābhino adhimānikassapi khīṇāsavassapi nighaṃso kathito, sukkhavipassakassa pana adhimānikassapi khīṇāsavassapi na kathito.
Tesaṃ dvinnampi nighaṃsaṃ dassetuṃ imaṃ desanaṃ ārabhi.
Samāpattilābhino hi adhimānikassa nighaṃse kathite sukkhavipassakassapi adhimānikassa kathitova hoti, samāpattilābhino ca khīṇāsavassa kathite sukkhavipassakakhīṇāsavassa kathitova hoti.
Etesaṃ pana dvinnaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sappāyāsappāyaṃ kathetuṃ imaṃ desanaṃ ārabhi.
Tattha siyā – puthujjanassa tāva ārammaṇaṃ asappāyaṃ hotu, khīṇāsavassa kathaṃ asappāyanti.
Yadaggena puthujjanassa asappāyaṃ, tadaggena khīṇāsavassāpi asappāyameva.
Visaṃ nāma jānitvā khāditampi ajānitvā khāditampi visameva.
Na hi khīṇāsavenapi “ahaṃ khīṇāsavo”ti asaṃvutena bhavitabbaṃ.
Chandarāgabyāpādenāti so avijjāsaṅkhāto visadoso chandarāgena ca byāpādena ca ruppati kuppati.
Saupādisesanti sagahaṇasesaṃ, upāditabbaṃ gaṇhitabbaṃ idha upādīti vuttaṃ.
Analañca te antarāyāyāti jīvitantarāyaṃ te kātuṃ asamatthaṃ.
Tadubhayenāti yā sā asappāyakiriyā ca yo visadoso ca, tena ubhayena.

Evameva khoti ettha saupādānasalluddhāro viya appahīno avijjāvisadoso daṭṭhabbo, asappāyakiriyāya ṭhitabhāvo viya chasu dvāresu asaṃvutakālo, tadubhayena vaṇe puthuttaṃ gate maraṇaṃ viya sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattanaṃ, maraṇamattaṃ dukkhaṃ viya aññatarāya garukāya saṃkiliṭṭhāya āpattiyā āpajjanaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.
Lokikāya paññāya lokikā hoti, lokuttarāya lokuttarā.
Iti viditvā nirupadhīti evaṃ jānitvā kilesupadhipahānā nirupadhi hoti, nirupādānoti attho.
Upadhisaṅkhaye vimuttoti upadhīnaṃ saṅkhayabhūte nibbāne ārammaṇato vimutto.
Idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti – taṇhakkhaye nibbāne ārammaṇato vimutto khīṇāsavo pañca kāmaguṇe sevituṃ, kāyaṃ vā upasaṃharissati cittaṃ vā uppādessatīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
Tassa phalabhāvato aggaphalapaññā, taṃsahagatā sammāsaṅkappādayo ca “aññā”ti vuttāti āha “aññāti arahattan”ti.
Catūhi padehi kathitā,“pariciṇṇā me bhagavā”tiādīsu viya na ekapadeneva.
“Lokuttaro dhammo adhigato mayā”ti maññanāmattaṃ adhimānoti dassento,“appatte pattasaññino”tiādimāha.
Uḷāratarabhāvena hi taṃ maggaphalapaññāya paccayo hutvā yāthāvato dubbiññeyyatāya vipassakaṃ visaṃvādeti.
Imaṃ pañhanti imaṃ suttaṃ gambhīraṃ lokuttarapaṭisaṃyuttaṃ attanā ñātuṃ icchitaṃ atthaṃ.
Visevamānāti kilesavise avamānentā, sāsanassa vā anupakāravirūpapaccaye sevamānā.
Evamassāti evaṃ vuttanayena tesaṃ karaṇahetu assa cittassa dhammadesanāvasena pavattassa.
Kilesehi āmasīyatīti āmisaṃ, lokepariyāpannaṃ āmisanti idha pañca kāmaguṇā adhippetāti tesu vaṭṭāmisabhāvepi labhite kāmāmisabhāvo siddhoti āha –
Kāmaguṇā hi vaṭṭassa vaḍḍhanato vaṭṭāmisaṃ, kāmetabbato kāmataṇhāya āmasitabbato kāmāmisaṃ, yebhūyyato sattalokassa āmisabhāvato lokāmisaṃ.
Āneñjasamāpattipaṭisaṃyuttāyāti kilesiñjanarahitatāya idha āneñjāti adhippetāhi heṭṭhimāhi arūpasamāpattīhi paṭisaṃyuttāya.
Evarūpoti lokāmisabhūtesu paccayesu adhimutto tanninno taggaruko tappabbhāro.
Ettāvatāti evaṃ saddhānaṃ manussānaṃ dassanena tesaṃ pavattitāsayena ca.
Sīsaṃ nikkhantaṃ hotīti lābhāsāya sīsaṃ bahi nikkhantaṃ viya hoti.
Udaraṃ phalitanti atibahubhaṇḍaṃ pakkhipiyamānaṃ pasibbakaṃ viya laddhabbassa atipahūtabhāvena udaraṃ phītaṃ hoti.
Yathā purimā dve arūpasamāpattiyo attano paccanīkakilesehi aniñjanato “aniñjā”ti vuccanti, evaṃ itarāpi.
Taṃ bhinnanti āneñjasaṃyojanaṃ bhinnaṃ vidhamitaṃ samatikkantaṃ tāsu samāpattīsu apekkhābhāvato.
Uparisamāpattilābhinoti ettha uparisamāpattīti arahattaphalasamāpatti adhippetā, arahato ca maggādhigameneva anāgāmiphalasamāpatti, sekkhānaṃ visayā heṭṭhimā phalasamāpattiyo paṭippassaddhā.

“Pañca kho ime, sunakkhatta, kāmaguṇā”tiādinā āraddhadesanā,“sammā nibbānādhimutto purisapuggalo”ti arahattakittanena niṭṭhāpitāti tato paraṃ,“ṭhānaṃ kho panā”tiādikā desanā,“pāṭiyekko anusandhī”ti vuttā.
Tattha yathā khīṇāsavassa samāpattilābhinoti yojanā, evaṃ vā khīṇāsavassa sukkhavipassakassāti yojetabbā.
Tassa paṭikkhepassa kāraṇaṃ dassetuṃ “samāpattilābhino hī”tiādi vuttaṃ.

Yathā sukkhavipassako adhimāniko samāpattilābhino samānayogakkhamo appatte pattasaññitāya bhedābhāvato, evaṃ sukkhavipassako khīṇāsavo samānayogakkhamo khīṇāsavabhāvena visesābhāvato, tasmā “samāpattilābhimhi kathite itaropi kathitova hotī”ti vuttaṃ.
Yadipi khīṇāsavassa asappāyārammaṇaṃ kilesānaṃ uppattiyā paccayo na hoti tesaṃ sabbaso samucchinnattā.
Etena “yathā visajānanaṃ appamāṇaṃ, vikāruppādanato pana taṃ pariharitabbaṃ, evaṃ pariññātampi vattu atthavisesābhāvena ekarūpamevāti taṃ pariharitabbamevā”ti dasseti.
Yattha sayaṃ nipatati uppajjati, tassa santānassa vippasannavasena ruppanato, visasaṅkhātassa dukkhassa mūlabhāvato ca “avijjāsaṅkhāto visadoso”ti vuttaṃ.
Rāgo hi uppajjamānova kusalacittappavattiyā okāsaṃ adento taṃ vibādhati;
tathābhūto saddhāsinehassa samathavipassanābhivuḍḍhiyā vamanena ca taṃ visoseti milāpeti.
Maraṇaṃ viya sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāyāvattanaṃ adhisīlasaṅkhātassa āyuno apetattā.
Maraṇamattaṃ dukkhaṃ viya āpattiyā āpajjanaṃ yathāvuttassa āyuno upapīḷanakabhāvato.
Imināva nayena opammasaṃsandananti ettha anupādisesasalluddhāro viya pahīno avijjāvisadoso;
sappāya … pe … susaṃvutakālo, tadubhayena vaṇe puthuttaṃ na gate maraṇābhāvo viya sikkhāya apaccakkhānaṃ, maraṇamattadukkhābhāvo viya aññatarāya saṃkiliṭṭhāya āpattiyā anāpajjananti yojanā veditabbā.
Paññā cettha lokiyā adhippetā, na lokuttarāti āha –

Khīṇāsavassa balanti uḷāratamesu dibbasadisesupi ārammaṇesu manacchaṭṭhānaṃ indriyānaṃ anupanamanahetubhūtaṃ susaṃvutakārisaṅkhātaṃ khīṇāsavabalaṃ dassento,“saṃvutakārī”ti vuttaṃ, ukkaṃsagatasativepullattā yathā asaṃvarassa asaṃvaro hoti, evaṃ satisampajaññabalena cakkhādidvārāni saṃvaritvā dassanādikiccakārī.
Evaṃ jānitvāti “upadhi dukkhassa mūlan”ti evaṃ vipassanāpaññāsahitāya maggapaññāya jānitvā.
Upadhīyati dukkhaṃ etehīti upadhī, kilesāti āha –
Tato eva upādīyati dukkhaṃ etehīti kilesā “upādānā” tipi vuccantīti āha –
Upadhī sammadeva khīyanti ettāti upadhisaṅkhayo, nibbānanti āha –
kāyūpasaṃhāro tāva tiṭṭhatu, tathā cittaṃ vā uppādessatīti etaṃ kāraṇaṃ natthīti.

Sotāpattiphalasacchikiriyavacanato kosambiyasutte (ma. ni.1.492) sotāpattimaggasammādiṭṭhi kathitā, idha pana “diṭṭhisāmaññagato viharati” cceva vuttattā,“imasmiṃ sutte sotāpattiphalasammādiṭṭhi vuttāti veditabbā”ti vuttaṃ.
Pāpakammassa appatā mahantatā sāvajjabhāvassa mudutikkhabhāvena veditabbāti āha “aṇunti appasāvajjaṃ.
